title: PearlVLA: Progressive Embodied Action-Plan Refinement in Latent Space
abstract: arXiv:2606.17924v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models face a trade-off between efficient action generation and explicit deliberation. Directly decoding actions from vision-language backbone representations enables low-latency control, whereas textual reasoning, pixel-level subgoals, or world-model evaluation of decoded actions can improve planning but incur substantial latency and computational cost. We propose PearlVLA, a VLA framework that progressively refines a VLM-derived latent plan using feedback from the predicted consequence of each intermediate plan. PearlVLA uses a frozen latent world model (LaWM) pretrained on action-free video. At each refinement round, the current plan produces a continuous latent action code, and the LaWM predicts the corresponding latent visual subgoal. A future-guided plan refiner uses this subgoal to update the plan, so each revision reshapes the next LaWM query. After K rounds, the refined plan is pass

translated_title: PearlVLA：潜空间中的渐进式具身动作-计划细化
translated_abstract: 当前的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在高效动作生成与显式深思式规划之间面临权衡。直接从视觉-语言骨干网络表示中解码动作可以实现低延迟控制，而文本推理、像素级子目标或对解码动作进行世界模型评估等方法虽然能够改善规划质量，却会带来显著的延迟和计算开销。我们提出了PearlVLA，这是一个VLA框架，它利用每个中间计划预测后果的反馈，对由VLM导出的潜空间计划进行渐进式细化。PearlVLA使用一个在无动作标注视频上预训练的冻结潜空间世界模型。在每一轮细化中，当前计划会生成一个连续的潜空间动作编码，LaWM据此预测相应的潜空间视觉子目标。一个面向未来的计划细化器利用该子目标来更新计划，因此每次修订都会重塑下一次LaWM查询。经过K轮细化后，细化后的计划被传递……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: PearlVLA提出了一种利用在无动作视频上预训练的冻结潜空间世界模型提供预测反馈、在潜空间中对VLM生成的动作计划进行渐进式细化的框架，从而在不引入显著延迟和计算开销的情况下兼顾低延迟控制与深思式规划能力。
en_tdlr: PearlVLA is a VLA framework that progressively refines a VLM-derived latent action plan in latent space using feedback from a frozen latent world model pretrained on action-free videos, balancing low-latency control with deliberative planning while avoiding substantial latency and computational cost.
